name: docs
description: Maintain project documentation: /docs:audit-docs verifies CLAUDE.md, READMEs, docs/ trees, .claude/commands, .claude/skills, .claude/rules, and architecture docs for stale claims about the codebase; /docs:enrich-claude-md investigates the codebase for useful, non-obvious facts missing from CLAUDE.md or .claude/rules and proposes additions, including suggesting a new nested CLAUDE.md for subtree-specific facts; /docs:revise captures learnings from the current session into CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, or .claude/rules. All three propose changes and apply only the ones you approve
